title: atelophragma jesupii
intro: Atelophragma jesupii, commonly known as the Mexican evening primrose, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Atelophragma jesupii include soothing skin irritations and wound healing, likely due to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
